editorial: Looking for a pulse‑quickening puzzle that keeps you guessing? Escape Room: Tournament of Champions drops six strangers into a dizzying maze of locked rooms, forcing them—and you—to piece together why they’re all linked. The film’s hallmark is its mirrored set design, turning each corridor into a psychological echo that pulls the characters deeper into dread. Though pacing stumbles when exposition swells, the constant pressure never lets your heartbeat falter. Ideal for fans of high‑stakes, mind‑bending suspense.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
